json.title: Unit Converter
json.summary: A small Python command-line tool that converts lengths (mm, cm, m, km, in, ft, yd, mi), masses (mg, g, kg, oz, lb, st) and temperatures (C, F, K), and prints conversion tables from a start to a stop value in steps. Results are rounded to four places unless --precision says otherwise, the way Python's round does (half to even). Temperatures below absolute zero are refused. Lengths convert through metres and masses through kilograms, with the factors in one table.
json.purpose: Convert a value between units of one kind, or tabulate a conversion.
entry: python -m converter.cli VALUE FROM TO [--precision N]
python -m converter.cli START FROM TO --table STOP STEP
